messages:
Maya (Product): Quick alignment request — Beacon private pilot launch criteria we need signoff on by Wed EOD:
• P95 latency < 250ms for 99% of pilot traffic
• Private KMS + HSM integration (attestation + rotation logs)
• Dedicated capacity reservation with burst policy
• No regressions vs customer eval set (auto-eval pass)
Who can own sequencing and blockers?

Kevin (Runtime): From runtime side — two things: the session KV-preload we discussed will change the execution path (kv-optimized model variant) and needs new kernel selection + quant profile. Expect ~2 weeks for kernel landing + perf validation. That impacts the earliest we can hit 250ms p95.

Priya (Infra): 2 weeks is optimistic given the VPC/networking approvals for private control plane. INF-4123 is open for subnet + peering; if approvals are prioritized we can do ~10 business days. Also need capacity request to ops for Dedicated pools.

Jordan (Eng): We can parallelize quant validation with infra prep. I can run quantization CI and early perf testing while infra works on networking. I'll need a short list of perf tests and smoke scripts.

Liam (Security): Security notes: customer requires HSM attestation + key rotation logs to their SIEM. We need an HSM integration plan, an updated threat model, and a short review (3-4 business days). Also callout: ensure no plaintext key material in logs or metrics.

Maya (Product): Proposed sequencing (draft):
Week 1 — infra approvals + HSM integration plan + open capacity request
Week 2 — runtime kernel landing + quant validation (parallel smoke infra)
Week 3 — smoke tests, cold-start scenarios, canary run (beacon-pilot-canary)
Week 4 — pilot toggle and CSM handoff
Fallback: route to hosted variant if latency SLO breached. Comments? :thinking_face:

Kevin (Runtime): Fallback plan: add route policy + circuit-breaker to route requests to hosted model variant (higher cost but lower infra risk). Basic implementation timeline: ~3 days after model variant is available. Example policy sketch:
```
route_policy: 
  - condition: p95_route_latency > 250ms for 2m
    action: switch_to_hosted_variant
    cooldown: 10m
```
We should also add a metric to detect KV-cache misses (cold starts).

Priya (Infra): Agree on fallback. I'll open DR-559 capacity request to reserve 2x pilot nodes and mark them for prewarm. Also will chase INF-4123 and try to get subnet approvals within 3 business days (will ping compliance).

Jordan (Eng): I'll own quant validation + smoke scripts. Will add cold-starts and prefix-caching scenarios. Plan: produce smoke script + perf dashboard queries by end of Week 1.

Liam (Security): I'll draft the HSM integration RFC and threat model today and post for review. If compliance needs additional attestations that may shift schedule — I'll surface immediately.

Maya (Product): Action items recap (owners):
• Infra approvals + capacity ticket — Priya (DR-559, INF-4123)
• HSM RFC + threat model — Liam
• Kernel + quant perf validation — Jordan + Kevin
• Fallback/circuit-breaker policy — Kevin + Runtime
• Smoke tests (cold-starts, canary) — Jordan
• Per-route P95 dashboard tile — Olivia
If no objections by Wed EOD I will lock this timeline and inform Sales/CSM.

Olivia (Observability): I can add a per-route P95 tile and a KV-cache miss rate panel. Target: tile + panels by Thu (will need metric names).

SRE Bot (deploybot): Deploybot: created canary environment 'beacon-pilot-canary' at 1832100120.

Kevin (Runtime): Noted. Also flag: last pilot we saw P95 spikes on prewarm-disabled nodes — we'll include prewarm toggles in the canary test.

Jordan (Eng): Adding cold-start and prewarm on/off matrix to smoke script. Will link PR when ready.

Maya (Product): Thanks. One more ask: Sales/CSM need clear 'launch gating' checklist (latency, security signoff, capacity). I'll draft and share — please add any required items to the checklist thread.

Priya (Infra): I'll update DR-559 with dedicated pool sizing and prewarm policy. ETA: ticket by EOD today.

Liam (Security): RFC posted — request reviews from Kevin + Priya. Will accept comments until Tue 5pm.

Maya (Product): Good progress, folks. If blockers pop up, mention @Maya and I'll escalate. Lock-in decision Wed EOD unless major risks are uncovered. :white_check_mark:
